_README: Posts that were PUBLISHED ON PRODUCTION and only later adopted into git.
For these, git answers the wrong question. A post's first commit is the date
SOMEONE COPIED IT INTO THE REPO, not the date it went live. gen-sitemap.py:122
already knew this ('an adoption changes when a file last moved in history
without touching a byte the reader sees') while check-schema-dates.py was built
on the opposite premise. This file is where the two stop contradicting each
other: the checker reads the expected datePublished FROM HERE for these paths,
and from git for everything else.
WHO WRITES IT: whoever performs an adoption, in the same commit as the adoption.
An adoption with no entry here is a post whose datePublished nothing can verify.
WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT: independent evidence that the value is TRUE. The
datePublished below is the production page's own claim, which is also what the
HTML says — so the checker's comparison is a declaration-vs-artifact match, not
a derivation. Its job is to make DRIFT visible and to stop fix-schema-dates.py
overwriting a true date with a false one. Independence comes from
`evidence.first_serve_utc`: an access-log row proving the page was served before
the adopting commit existed. You cannot serve a file that does not exist.
KEYED BY REPO-RELATIVE PATH, never basename. blog/index.html and
how-to/index.html collapse to one string under a basename key, and the lane that
loses is silent.

_evidence_source.expires_approx: 2026-08-15 (30 daily rotations; the 16-Jul rows age out first)
_evidence_source.note: Prod access logs, static_* family, status 200 only. A 404 row proves NON-existence and must never mint a bound. Counts: buffet 14, cai-fan 14, intermittent-fasting 23, kopi 19.

blog/how-to-log-a-buffet.html.note: Served to a third party (Alibaba Cloud, curl/8.14.1) 898s BEFORE the adopting commit. The git date is falsified, not merely doubted.

blog/how-to-log-cai-fan.html.note: Same 898s gap. State it in SECONDS — '16 Jul vs 17 Jul' is a midnight-SGT artifact (23:48 vs 00:03) and reporting it as a one-day gap re-imports the exact ambiguity this file exists to kill.

blog/how-to-log-kopi-and-teh.html.note: WEAKEST OF THE FOUR AND THE FIELD SAYS SO: the first serve is OUR OWN deploy-verification curl from our egress IP, so it is an existence proof but NOT independent (third_party=false). 2026-07-21 is the production page's own value and is the truer date - the post was live on the 21st. Do NOT 'fix' it to the adopting commit's date 2026-07-22; that falsifies content to green a broken instrument. This is the entry the old TZ bucket failed to spare, purely because the adoption ran at 11:08 instead of 00:03.
